metadata.name: InternalReactionOverlay+
metadata.description:
基于内置反应桌宠InternalReactionOverlay模组改进而来 可以让桌宠根据游戏内的事件播放动画了 目前已有事件：进入BOSS房、受到伤害、角色半血、发现不同等级道具（需要ReactionAPI）、使用主动/副主动道具、使用药丸、使用卡牌等 v3：新增桌宠角色素材池（最多5个角色，一个角色一个文件夹），游戏内Mod Config Menu一键切换角色并调整全部动画配置 v3.1：每个桌宠角色独立保存全部动画/外观配置（互不影响，切换角色自动应用其专属配置，旧存档自动迁移） v3.2：药丸/卡牌动画分离（各自专属动画，缺素材自动回退共用动画）、桌宠突脸（触发指定事件时滑出画面，放大到窗口高度从底部冲入正中央播放后返回，方向/事件/时长可配）、Lost/堕化Lost无圣盾时常态切换悲伤贴图 可以通过替换png图片帧的方式替换桌宠动画,内置两套可选素材（超天酱Angle/糖糖TangTang） 详情见README.md / README_en.md
---
InternalReactionOverlay+ interactive desktop pet overlay (Repentance+) Plays reaction animations on in-game events: boss fights, damage, half health, item quality (ReactionAPI), active item usage, pill usage, card usage, and more. v3: desktop-pet character pool (up to 5 characters, one folder each), switchable in-game via Mod Config Menu with full animation settings. v3.1: per-character settings profiles (independent animation/appearance config per pet, auto-applied on switch, old saves auto-migrated). v3.2: separate pill/card animations (auto-fallback to shared animation when assets missing), pet popup (on a configurable event the pet slides out, zooms to window height, enters from bottom center, plays at screen center, then returns), and sad idle for Lost/Tainted Lost without Holy Mantle. See README_en.md for details.
